entries.zh: 撒开、泼洒开来；散播（播開）
entries.en: to spill; to scatter, to spread about, to sprinkle

entries.zh: 倒出、泼洒（水等倾泻流溢）
entries.en: to be spilled over, to be poured out (of water or liquid)
entries.notes: H 栏第二字「擋/擔」存疑且音写不合常规；据首字「到（倒）」与西语 derramarse（水倾泻）定为倒出、泼洒

entries.zh: 泼洒落地；乱泼一地（不分方向随意泼洒）
entries.en: to spill or splash indiscriminately on the ground

entries.zh: 洋溢；满溢外流（水满而漫溢）
entries.en: to overflow, to brim over (of water)
entries.notes: L 栏「Veno」所指不明（疑为 vaso/vena 之类误读），据 H「洋溢」与 M/R 音证（iâng īc）定为满溢外流

entries.zh: 摊派；按名派定、造册指派（官府按名册摊派税役、指派名额）
entries.en: apportioned levy (derrama), forced assessment; assignment of names, enrollment of those assessed (repartimiento roll)

entries.zh: 熔化、熔解（熔炼金属等物）
entries.en: to melt, to fuse, to smelt
to melt metals, to smelt metal/ore

entries.zh: 熔化；浑融化开（金属化成液态）
entries.en: to melt, to dissolve completely, to fuse
entries.notes: L「melates」疑为「metales」，H 首字「渾/潿」存疑；据西语义与「化」字定为熔化、浑融化开

entries.zh: 熔化；金属熔液（已熔开的「金属水」）
entries.en: to melt; molten metal, metal run to liquid
entries.notes: L「derrenido」疑为「derretido」，H 首字「鍂/鉎」难辨；据「…水」（lé-chúi 类熔液）与西语义（已熔金属）定为金属熔液

entries.en: to knock down, to overturn, to topple
(of the wind) to blow something down, to knock down
entries.notes: M 栏末音节 [疑:to/ro] 已由 H 栏「倒」（tò）消解

entries.zh: 敲平凹痕、修复原凸之形；平整复原
entries.en: to knock out dents, to restore a dented thing to shape; smoothed of dents
entries.notes: 汉字仅「凸」一字，据金属器修整语境推断：敲去凹痕后复原凸面（desabollar）

entries.zh: 淡而无味；味道寡淡（正淡）
entries.notes: R 栏「fān」与「淡」之官话对音（dàn/tām）不合，疑误读；据 L、H「淡」及 M「tām, chiã tã」定为味淡

entries.zh: 性情乖拗、执拗难相处（阴沉拗戾）
entries.notes: H 第二字「拗/漚」存疑、首字「問」疑为「悶」；据西语 mala condicionados（品性不佳）定为乖戾拗逆

entries.en: a letter of challenge, written defiance (cartel)

entries.zh: 散乱、零乱（船上舱货堆放凌乱）；蓬松散乱
entries.en: disorder, disarray (in the ship's stowed cargo); loose, unkempt, disheveled
entries.notes: H 首字「鬅/蓬」、M 末音节 zong/sang 存疑，「g.」疑为 v.g.（例如）之缩写；据 H「鬅鬆」与西语 descompuesto 定为蓬松散乱
